@'
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
run=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
root=Path.cwd()
base="TC-RG-001-A-3-20260905-31bec90c"
record_path=root/"docs/practice"/f"{base}-conclusion.md"
commands_path=root/"docs/practice"/f"{base}-commands.md"
record=record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
commands=commands_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
template=(root/"docs/practice/refund-record-template.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
read=lambda n:json.loads((run/n).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
logs=read("command-log.json")
report=read("report-after-approval.json")
facts=read("verification-checks.json")
version=read("execution-version.json")
preserved=read("preserved-files-sha256.json")
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
headings=[]
in_block=False
for line in commands.splitlines():
    if line.startswith("````"):
        in_block=not in_block
    elif not in_block and re.match(r"^## [0-9]+[.] ",line):
        headings.append(line)
inputs=[e["input"] for e in logs["entries"] if e["type"]=="stdin"]
expected_inputs=[facts["user_messages"][0]+"\n","/approve "+facts["proposal"]["proposal_id"]+"\n","YES\n","/exit\n"]
entry=lambda stage:next(e for e in logs["entries"] if e["stage"]==stage)
checks={
 "template_sections_preserved":re.findall(r"^## (.+)$",record,re.M)==re.findall(r"^## (.+)$",template,re.M),
 "both_model_answers_saved_verbatim":all(t["answer"] in record for t in report["turns"]),
 "all_13_execution_entries_exported":len(logs["entries"])==len(headings)==13,
 "only_planned_inputs":inputs==expected_inputs,
 "pending_list_captured":("待确认：/approve "+facts["proposal"]["proposal_id"]+" | payment-a-second | CNY 100.00") in entry("first_response")["output"],
 "yes_screen_captured":"支付：payment-a-second；金额：CNY 100.00" in entry("approve_prompt")["output"],
 "normal_exit":entry("exit").get("exit_code")==0,
 "all_shell_commands_succeeded":all(e.get("exit_code")==0 for e in logs["entries"] if e["type"]=="command" and e["stage"]!="launch"),
 "state_checks_passed":all(facts["checks"].values()),
 "raw_report_hash_matches":sha(run/"report-after-approval.json")==facts["report_sha256"],
 "history_files_unchanged":all(Path(n).is_file() and sha(Path(n))==h for n,h in preserved.items()),
 "source_files_unchanged":all(sha(root/"agent_quality_lab"/n)==h for n,h in version["source_sha256"].items()),
 "unverified_wording_retained":facts["wording_review"]["unverified_statement"] in record and "证据不足" in record,
 "user_result_confirmation_pending":facts["user_confirmation"]=="pending" and logs["final_result_confirmation"]=="pending user confirmation" and "最终判定待用户确认" in record
}
targets=re.findall(r"\]\(([^\n)]+)\)",record+commands.split("## 1.")[0])
receipt=str(run/"artifact-verification.json").replace("\\","/")
broken=[s for s in targets if not Path(s).is_file() and s!=receipt]
checks["artifact_links_resolve_except_pending_receipt"]=not broken
files=[record_path,commands_path,*sorted(p for p in run.iterdir() if p.is_file())]
result={"case":"TC-RG-001 A-3","checked_at":datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),"checks":checks,"broken_links":broken,
 "history_count":len(preserved),
 "files":[{"path":str(p),"bytes":p.stat().st_size,"sha256":sha(p)} for p in files],
 "git_status":subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","safe.directory=<REPO>","status","--short"],text=True),
 "note":"Artifact checks do not replace the user's final QA judgment. No model or business operation was rerun."}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
if not all(checks.values()):
    raise SystemExit("Artifact verification failed: "+", ".join(k for k,v in checks.items() if not v))
